record.prompt: Add km_to_miles to units/convert.py, matching the style of the existing functions (type hints, one-line docstring), and use the exact inverse of the factor miles_to_km uses.
record.final_answer:
Added to units/convert.py:9-11:

    def km_to_miles(km: float) -> float:
        """Convert kilometres to statute miles."""
        return km / 1.609344

It divides by the same 1.609344 literal miles_to_km multiplies by, so it's the exact inverse rather than a separately rounded constant. Round-trip check with real output: km_to_miles(miles_to_km(v)) == v exactly for 1.0, 0.0, 42.195 and 1e6; km_to_miles(1.609344) == 1.0 and miles_to_km(km_to_miles(1.0)) == 1.0. Note there's no test suite in the repo (no pytest, no tests/), so that's the only verification possible.
